script: Now, where do you host your portfolio for free? You have four good choices. First, a single Google Drive folder, shared as anyone with the link can view. Second, a free Canva design shared as a link. Third, a free LinkedIn featured section, or a free Behance profile. Fourth, a WhatsApp Business catalogue, which clients can open on their phone. A good portfolio page has five things. Your name, your skill, and one line on what you offer. Three to six samples, each with a short caption that explains the problem and the result. One review, even a short one from a friend, and say honestly if it is a practice project. A clear way to contact you, such as a WhatsApp button. And your working hours, your turnaround time, and the languages you work in. Let us look at one sample from start to finish. Imagine a small tuition centre that teaches mathematics to children. Its owner has no poster for the new term.
